entries.correct_answer: খ) The baby came to me laughing
entries.explanation: 'হাসতে হাসতে' বোঝাতে present participle 'laughing' ব্যবহৃত। সঠিক: The baby came to me laughing.

entries.question_text: The antonym of 'inimical' —
entries.options_raw: ক) hostile খ) friendly গ) indifferent ঘ) angry
entries.explanation: 'Inimical' (adj.) মানে শত্রুভাবাপন্ন/প্রতিকূল (hostile-এর সমার্থক); বিপরীত 'friendly' — বন্ধুভাবাপন্ন।

entries.question_text: He waited until the plane —
entries.options_raw: ক) did not take off খ) take off গ) had no taken off ঘ) had taken off
entries.explanation: Principal clause past ('waited'); until-clause এর পূর্ববর্তী কাজ হলে past perfect — 'had taken off'। সঠিক: He waited until the plane had taken off.

entries.question_text: My uncle arrived while I ___ the dinner.
entries.options_raw: ক) would cook খ) had cooked গ) cook ঘ) was cooking
entries.explanation: 'While' যুক্ত ও অপর অংশ past indefinite ('arrived') হলে while-clause-এ past continuous ('was cooking') বসে।

entries.question_text: Which is the correct sentence?

options.label: খ
options.text: I shall avail of the opportunity

options.label: গ
options.text: I shall avail for the opportunity

options.label: ঘ
options.text: I shall avail myself of the opportunity

entries.options_raw: ক) I shall avail the opportunity খ) I shall avail of the opportunity গ) I shall avail for the opportunity ঘ) I shall avail myself of the opportunity
entries.correct_answer: ঘ) I shall avail myself of the opportunity
entries.explanation: 'Avail' এর সঠিক ব্যবহার — 'avail oneself of something' (কোনো সুযোগ কাজে লাগানো)। Reflexive pronoun ('myself') সহ ব্যবহৃত।

entries.question_text: ___ mother arose in her.
entries.options_raw: ক) A খ) The গ) An ঘ) No Article
entries.explanation: বিশেষ অর্থে/গুণে ('মাতৃসত্তা') noun-এর আগে 'the' বসে। 'The mother arose in her' — অর্থাৎ তার মধ্যে মাতৃত্ববোধ জাগ্রত হলো।

entries.question_text: Jerry was deprived of motherly affection. Here the word 'motherly' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) an adverb খ) an adjective গ) a noun ঘ) none
entries.explanation: '-ly' সত্ত্বেও 'motherly' একটি adjective (মাতৃসুলভ), noun 'affection'-কে বিশেষায়িত করছে।

entries.question_text: Panic seized me. The passive form will be —
entries.options_raw: ক) I was seized by panic খ) I was seized from panic গ) I was seized with panic ঘ) I was seized into panic
entries.correct_answer: গ) I was seized with panic
entries.explanation: 'Seize with' নির্দিষ্ট collocation — passive-এ 'be seized with something' (কোনো আবেগে বিধ্বস্ত হওয়া)। সঠিক: I was seized with panic.

entries.question_text: The singular form of 'criteria' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) criterion খ) criterium গ) criterii ঘ) criterius
entries.explanation: 'Criteria' গ্রিক-উদ্ভূত plural noun; singular 'criterion' (মানদণ্ড)। অনুরূপ: phenomenon → phenomena; medium → media।

entries.question_text: The Second World War broke ____ in September, 1939.
entries.options_raw: ক) out খ) through গ) away ঘ) in
entries.explanation: 'Break out' phrasal verb — (যুদ্ধ, মহামারি, দাঙ্গা) হঠাৎ শুরু হওয়া। যেমন: World War II broke out in 1939.

entries.question_text: He will come in no time. Here the idiom 'in no time' means —
entries.options_raw: ক) never in future খ) soon গ) not in future ঘ) not ever
entries.explanation: 'In no time' idiom — খুব দ্রুত/অল্প সময়ের মধ্যে (very soon/quickly)। যেমন: I will finish it in no time.

entries.question_text: I am entitled ____ a share of the profit. The correct preposition is —
entries.options_raw: ক) to খ) for গ) from ঘ) into
entries.explanation: 'Entitled to something' নির্দিষ্ট collocation — কোনো কিছুর অধিকারী হওয়া। সঠিক: I am entitled to a share of the profit.

entries.question_text: What kind of verb is the word 'went' in the sentence: "The dog went mad"?
entries.options_raw: ক) Transitive verb খ) Causative verb গ) Factitive verb ঘ) Copulative verb
entries.explanation: 'Went' এখানে linking/copulative verb — subject 'The dog'-কে subject complement 'mad'-এর সঙ্গে যুক্ত করছে (be, seem, appear, become, go — এর মতো)।

entries.question_text: The correct translation of "দুঃখের প্রয়োজনীয়তা মধুর" is —

options.text: Sweet is the uses of adversity.

options.label: ঘ

entries.explanation: শেক্সপিয়রের 'As You Like It' নাটকের বিখ্যাত উক্তি: 'Sweet are the uses of adversity' — Subject 'the uses' (plural) → verb 'are'। NTRCA-স্বীকৃত অনুবাদ এটাই।

entries.question_text: The antonym of 'Honorary' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) Literary খ) Honorable গ) Salaried ঘ) Official
entries.explanation: 'Honorary' মানে অবৈতনিক/সম্মানসূচক (unpaid); বিপরীত 'salaried' — বেতনভুক্ত।

entries.question_text: A person who treats mental illness is called —
entries.options_raw: ক) a psychiatrist খ) a psychologist গ) a therapist ঘ) a psychoanalyst
entries.explanation: 'Psychiatrist' মেডিকেল ডাক্তার, যিনি মানসিক রোগ (mental illness) নির্ণয় ও চিকিৎসা করেন (ওষুধ প্রদান-সহ)। Psychologist ওষুধ দিতে পারেন না।

entries.question_text: No article is used before —
entries.options_raw: ক) a pronoun খ) an adjective গ) a noun ঘ) an adverb
entries.explanation: Article (a/an/the) সাধারণত noun বা adjective + noun-এর আগে বসে; pronoun-এর আগে কখনো article ব্যবহৃত হয় না।

entries.question_text: A person whose 'head' is in the 'clouds' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) proud খ) a day dreamer গ) an aviator ঘ) useless
entries.explanation: 'Head in the clouds' idiom — অবাস্তব চিন্তায় মগ্ন, দিবাস্বপ্নে ভাসমান ব্যক্তি (day dreamer)।

entries.question_text: I do not think you will have any difficulty ___ a driving license.
entries.options_raw: ক) to get খ) in getting গ) for getting ঘ) get
entries.explanation: 'Have difficulty in + verb-ing' — নির্দিষ্ট গঠন। সঠিক: any difficulty in getting a driving license.

entries.question_text: I decided to go ___ with my friend as I needed some exercise.
entries.options_raw: ক) to a walk খ) for walking গ) for a walk ঘ) walk
entries.explanation: 'Go for a walk' — নির্দিষ্ট collocation (হাঁটতে যাওয়া)। অনুরূপ: go for a swim, go for a ride।

entries.question_text: If I had known you were coming —

options.text: I would go to the station

options.label: গ
options.text: I would have gone to the station

options.label: ঘ
options.text: I would be going to the station

entries.correct_answer: গ) I would have gone to the station
entries.explanation: Third conditional structure — If + past perfect (had known), main clause 'would have + V3' (would have gone)।

entries.question_text: তিনি সৎ লোক ছিলেন, তাই না?

options.label: খ
options.text: He was an honest man, wasn't he?

entries.question_text: আমি এইমাত্র তোমার চিঠি পেয়েছি।

entries.question_text: গুজবে কান দেওয়া উচিত নয়।

options.text: We should not give our ear on rumour.

entries.explanation: 'Give ear to' idiom — মনোযোগ দেওয়া/কান দেওয়া। সাধারণ উপদেশে 'One should' গঠন যথার্থ।

entries.question_text: সে হাঁপাতে হাঁপাতে এখানে আসল।
entries.options_raw: ক) He has come here exhausted. খ) He had come here running. গ) He came here hurriedly. ঘ) He came here panting.
entries.explanation: 'Panting' = হাঁপাতে হাঁপাতে (breathing quickly)। Present participle হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত। সঠিক: He came here panting.

entries.question_text: কিছু করার আগে ভালো করে ভেবে নাও।
entries.options_raw: ক) Think before you do anything. খ) Look before you leap. গ) Look before you do. ঘ) Think before you leap.
entries.explanation: বিখ্যাত প্রবাদ 'Look before you leap' — লাফানোর আগে দেখে নাও; অর্থাৎ কাজ করার আগে ভালো করে ভাবো।

entries.question_text: The noun form of 'broad' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) broadly খ) breath গ) broaden ঘ) breadth
entries.explanation: Broad (adj., চওড়া) → Breadth (noun, প্রস্থ)। Broaden (verb, চওড়া করা); broadly (adv.)। 'Breath' (শ্বাস) সম্পূর্ণ ভিন্ন শব্দ।

entries.explanation: নির্দিষ্ট একক পর্বতের নামের পূর্বে article ব্যবহৃত হয় না। যেমন — Mount Everest, Mount Fuji, Mount Kilimanjaro। তবে পর্বতমালার নামের আগে 'the' বসে (the Himalayas)।

entries.question_text: The verb form of 'deceit' is:
entries.options_raw: ক) deceitful খ) deceitfully গ) decisive ঘ) deceive
entries.explanation: Deceit (noun) → Deceive (verb, প্রতারণা করা)। Deceitful (adj.), deceitfully (adv.)।

entries.question_text: Slow and steady — the race.
entries.options_raw: ক) win খ) wins গ) has won ঘ) won
entries.explanation: 'Slow and steady wins the race' — বিখ্যাত প্রবাদ; universal truth তাই present indefinite এবং singular verb 'wins'। দুই adjective মিলে single conceptual subject।

entries.question_text: 'A rolling stone gathers no moss.' Here 'rolling' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) a participle খ) an adjective গ) a verb ঘ) a gerund
entries.explanation: 'Rolling' এখানে present participle — noun 'stone'-কে বিশেষায়িত করছে (adjective হিসেবে কাজ করলেও এটি verb-এর -ing form)। Gerund হলে subject হত; এখানে 'stone'-এর গুণ।

entries.question_text: What would be the right synonym for 'initiative'?
entries.options_raw: ক) apathy খ) enterprise গ) indolence ঘ) activity
entries.explanation: 'Initiative' = উদ্যোগ, স্বতঃপ্রণোদিত কর্ম। সবচেয়ে কাছাকাছি সমার্থক 'enterprise' — উদ্যোক্তামনস্কতা/উদ্যোগ। Apathy = উদাসীনতা; indolence = আলস্য।

entries.options_raw: ক) to do it. খ) do it. গ) in doing it. ঘ) from doing it.
entries.explanation: 'Prohibit somebody from doing something' — নির্দিষ্ট collocation। 'Prohibit' এর সঙ্গে preposition 'from' + gerund বসে।

entries.question_text: "Call to mind" means —
entries.options_raw: ক) fantacize খ) attend গ) remember ঘ) request
entries.explanation: 'Call to mind' idiom — মনে করা/স্মরণ করা (to remember/recall)।

entries.question_text: He fathered the plane. Here the word 'father' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) a noun খ) an adverb গ) an adjective ঘ) a verb
entries.explanation: 'Father' এখানে verb হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত — 'to father' মানে সৃষ্টি করা/উদ্ভাবন করা। 'The plane' এর object; তাই 'fathered' — past tense verb।

entries.question_text: Price for bicycles can run ________ Tk. 2,000.
entries.options_raw: ক) as high as খ) so high as গ) as high to ঘ) as high for
entries.explanation: 'As high as' phrase — সর্বোচ্চ পরিমাণ/মূল্য বোঝাতে ব্যবহৃত। যেমন: Prices can run as high as Tk. 2,000 — সাইকেলের দাম ২০০০ টাকা পর্যন্ত হতে পারে।

entries.question_text: Walk fast lest you _________ miss the bus.
entries.options_raw: ক) will খ) can গ) could ঘ) should
entries.explanation: 'Lest' conjunction-এর পর subject + should + bare infinitive। তাই 'lest you should miss'।

entries.question_text: The idiom 'put up with' means —
entries.options_raw: ক) stay together খ) tolerate গ) keep trust ঘ) protect
entries.explanation: 'Put up with' phrasal verb — সহ্য করা (to tolerate)। যেমন: I can't put up with his rude behaviour any longer।

entries.question_text: He _______ to see us if he had been able to do.
entries.options_raw: ক) would come খ) would have come গ) may had come ঘ) would may come
entries.explanation: Third conditional structure: If + subject + had + V3, subject + would have + V3। 'If he had been able' → 'would have come'।

entries.correct_answer: খ) He is better than and superior to me.
entries.explanation: 'Better' এর পরে 'than', কিন্তু 'superior' এর পরে 'to' (superior to, inferior to, senior to, junior to, prior to)। তাই প্রতিটি adjective-এর নিজস্ব preposition বজায় রাখতে হবে।

entries.question_text: Select the meaning of the word 'stagflation'.
entries.options_raw: ক) controlled prices খ) economic slow down গ) a disintegrating government ঘ) cultural dullness
entries.explanation: 'Stagflation' = stagnation + inflation। অর্থাৎ একইসাথে অর্থনৈতিক মন্দা (economic slow down) ও উচ্চ মূল্যস্ফীতি — অর্থশাস্ত্রে একটি জটিল অবস্থা।

entries.question_text: The word 'permissive' means —
entries.options_raw: ক) polite খ) law-abiding গ) submissive ঘ) liberal
entries.explanation: 'Permissive' (adj.) — অনুমতিশীল/উদার (allowing much freedom)। সবচেয়ে কাছাকাছি সমার্থক 'liberal'।

entries.question_text: What would be the right antonym for 'annihilate' —
entries.options_raw: ক) establish খ) destroy গ) obliterate ঘ) extinguish
entries.explanation: 'Annihilate' = সম্পূর্ণরূপে ধ্বংস করা। বিপরীত 'establish' — প্রতিষ্ঠা/গঠন করা। 'Destroy', 'obliterate', 'extinguish' সবই সমার্থক।

entries.question_text: The synonym of the word 'scanty' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) copious খ) ample গ) meagre ঘ) abundant
entries.explanation: 'Scanty' = অপ্রতুল/অল্প। সবচেয়ে কাছাকাছি সমার্থক 'meagre' (also 'meager') — সামান্য/অপর্যাপ্ত। Copious, ample, abundant — সবই বিপরীত (প্রচুর) অর্থ।

entries.question_text: I have applied for the post of a Lecturer ________ English.
entries.options_raw: ক) at খ) of গ) for ঘ) in
entries.explanation: 'Lecturer in [subject]' — নির্দিষ্ট বিষয়ের প্রভাষক বোঝাতে 'in' preposition ব্যবহৃত হয়। যেমন — Lecturer in English/History।

entries.question_text: The principal along with his students ______ planting trees for two hours.
entries.options_raw: ক) have been খ) has been গ) is ঘ) are
entries.explanation: 'Along with', 'with', 'as well as', 'together with' — এসব phrase দ্বারা যুক্ত noun main subject-এর সংখ্যা পরিবর্তন করে না। এখানে subject 'The principal' (singular) এবং সময় 'for two hours' → present perfect continuous — 'has been planting'।

entries.question_text: Which one is a correct sentence?

options.label: গ

entries.explanation: 'Information' uncountable noun → singular verb 'is'। অন্যগুলোর ত্রুটি: 'Every student is' (singular), 'Ten kilometers is too far' (একটি দূরত্ব-একক singular ধরা হয়), 'Two-thirds' (bare fraction plural)।

entries.question_text: Do or die (Make it Simple)

entries.correct_answer: খ) Without doing you will die
entries.explanation: Imperative + 'or' যুক্ত compound → simple রূপান্তরে 'Without + verb-ing, subject + will/shall + verb' গঠন ব্যবহৃত হয়। 'Do or die' → 'Without doing you will die'।

entries.question_text: Academic is similar to —
entries.options_raw: ক) scholar খ) scholared গ) scholastic ঘ) scholastics
entries.explanation: 'Academic' (adj.) ও 'Scholastic' (adj.) — দুটোই শিক্ষা/পাণ্ডিত্য-সম্পর্কিত অর্থে সমার্থক। Scholar = পণ্ডিত (noun)।

entries.question_text: What is the synonym of 'remarkable'?
entries.options_raw: ক) Noteworthy খ) Remark গ) Praiseworthy ঘ) Memorable
entries.explanation: 'Remarkable' মানে লক্ষণীয়/উল্লেখযোগ্য। 'Noteworthy' সরাসরি সমার্থক (worth noting)। Praiseworthy (প্রশংসনীয়) ও memorable (স্মরণীয়) সংশ্লিষ্ট হলেও সরাসরি সমার্থক নয়।

entries.question_text: All his hopes were _____
entries.options_raw: ক) null and void খ) nipped in the bud গ) out of date ঘ) now and then
entries.explanation: 'Nipped in the bud' idiom — অঙ্কুরেই বিনষ্ট হওয়া। আশা-আকাঙ্ক্ষা শুরুতেই ধ্বংস হওয়া বোঝাতে ব্যবহৃত। 'Null and void' = আইনগতভাবে বাতিল।

entries.question_text: May Bangladesh prosper ______
entries.options_raw: ক) day to day খ) day by day গ) day with day ঘ) day on day
entries.explanation: 'Day by day' নির্দিষ্ট idiomatic phrase — ক্রমান্বয়ে/দিন দিন। তাই 'May Bangladesh prosper day by day' — সঠিক।

entries.question_text: Noun form of 'guilty' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) guiltness খ) guilt গ) guilting ঘ) guiltys
entries.explanation: Guilty (adj.) → Guilt (noun, দোষ/অপরাধবোধ)। 'Guiltiness' শব্দ থাকলেও প্রধান noun form 'guilt'।

entries.question_text: 'Pros and cons' means —
entries.options_raw: ক) details খ) liberate গ) avoid ঘ) angry
entries.explanation: 'Pros and cons' idiom — কোনো কিছুর পক্ষে ও বিপক্ষে দিকগুলো, অর্থাৎ বিস্তারিত বিচার (details)।

entries.question_text: The girls water the plants. Here 'water' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) noun খ) verb গ) adjective ঘ) adverb
entries.explanation: এখানে 'water' subject 'The girls' এর ক্রিয়া হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত (গাছে জল দেয়া), তাই verb। একই শব্দ ভিন্ন বাক্যে noun-ও হতে পারে (I drink water)।

entries.question_text: Rina proceeded as though she (know) everything.
entries.options_raw: ক) knows খ) had known গ) knew ঘ) known

entries.question_text: 'বাতিটি নিভাও' — Translate it —
entries.options_raw: ক) Put on the lamp খ) Put out the lamp গ) Put off the lamp ঘ) Put up the lamp
entries.explanation: 'Put out' phrasal verb — নিভানো (আলো/আগুন)। 'Put off' = স্থগিত করা; 'Put on' = পরিধান করা/চালু করা। তাই 'বাতিটি নিভাও' = Put out the lamp.

entries.question_text: Mr. Rohan is very friendly. Here 'friendly' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) adverb খ) noun গ) adjective ঘ) pronoun
entries.explanation: '-ly' প্রত্যয় থাকলেও 'friendly' একটি adjective (বন্ধুত্বপূর্ণ); 'Mr. Rohan' এর গুণ প্রকাশ করছে। অনুরূপ adjective: lovely, timely, cowardly, manly।

entries.question_text: Walk fast lest the train (miss).
entries.options_raw: ক) would miss খ) should be missed গ) will be missed ঘ) will miss
entries.explanation: 'Lest' conjunction → পরে subject + should + verb; এখানে subject 'the train' passive-এ 'should be missed' — ট্রেনটি যেন মিস না হয়।

entries.question_text: It is high time we (give up) smoking.
entries.options_raw: ক) give up খ) gave up গ) given up ঘ) should give up
entries.explanation: 'It is high time' এর পর subject + past simple (subjunctive) বসে; বর্তমান কালীন হলেও verb past form নেয়। তাই 'gave up'।

entries.question_text: The old man was very weak. His health broke _______ under the pressure of work.
entries.options_raw: ক) down খ) upon গ) through ঘ) away
entries.explanation: 'Break down' phrasal verb — স্বাস্থ্য/মন/যন্ত্র ভেঙে পড়া। কাজের চাপে স্বাস্থ্য ভেঙে পড়া অর্থে 'broke down' সঠিক।

entries.question_text: He made me _______ the car.

entries.question_text: He was one of the worst men in the world (Make Positive).

options.label: ঘ
options.text: Very few men in the world were not so bad as he.

entries.options_raw: ক) Very few men in the world were as bad as he. খ) Very few men in the world was so bad as he. গ) Very few men in the world was so bad so he. ঘ) Very few men in the world were not so bad as he.
entries.correct_answer: ক) Very few men in the world were as bad as he.
entries.explanation: Superlative ('one of the worst') → Positive-এ 'Very few X are/were as ... as Y' গঠন। Subject 'Very few men' (plural) → verb 'were'। সঠিক: 'Very few men in the world were as bad as he'।

entries.question_text: His behaviour surprised me. (Passive)

options.label: খ

options.label: গ

options.text: I was surprised at his behaviour

entries.correct_answer: ঘ) I was surprised at his behaviour
entries.explanation: 'Surprise' verb-এর passive-এ সাধারণত 'be + surprised at' collocation ব্যবহৃত হয়। Active-এর simple past ('surprised') → passive-এ 'was/were surprised'। সঠিক: I was surprised at his behaviour.

entries.question_text: While living in poverty, the poet had to ______ a great deal of sufferings.
entries.options_raw: ক) see through খ) put up with গ) pass by ঘ) fall back
entries.explanation: 'Put up with' phrasal verb — সহ্য করা (to tolerate)। দুঃখ-কষ্ট সহ্য করা অর্থে উপযুক্ত। 'See through' = ধরে ফেলা; 'Pass by' = অতিক্রম করা; 'Fall back' = পিছিয়ে পড়া।

entries.question_text: The word 'Camouflage' means _____
entries.options_raw: ক) disguise খ) difficult গ) heavy ঘ) dangerous
entries.explanation: 'Camouflage' মানে ছদ্মবেশ ধারণ করা/গোপন করা (to hide by disguise)। সামরিক ও প্রাণিজগতে পরিবেশের সঙ্গে মিলিয়ে নিজেকে লুকানোর কৌশল বোঝায়।

entries.question_text: It burns the prettiest of any wood. (Positive)

entries.correct_answer: গ) No other wood burns as pretty as it.
entries.explanation: Superlative ('the prettiest of any') → Positive-এ 'No other X ... as ... as ...' গঠন। Singular subject 'wood' → verb 'burns' (s-সহ)। সঠিক: No other wood burns as pretty as it.

entries.question_text: Anybody can apply for the post. Here 'anybody' is ______
entries.options_raw: ক) Possessive pronoun খ) Indefinite pronoun গ) Distributive pronoun ঘ) Relative pronoun
entries.explanation: Anybody, anyone, somebody, nobody, everyone, none — এসব pronoun নির্দিষ্ট কোনো ব্যক্তি/বস্তু নির্দেশ করে না, তাই Indefinite Pronoun।

entries.question_text: 'Once in a blue moon' means _____
entries.options_raw: ক) full moon night খ) very rarely গ) very often ঘ) moonlit night
entries.explanation: 'Once in a blue moon' idiom — খুব কদাচিৎ, প্রায় ঘটে না এমন। যেমন: He visits us once in a blue moon.

entries.question_text: I opened the door as soon as I _____ the bell.
entries.options_raw: ক) have heard খ) was hearing গ) heard ঘ) am heard
entries.explanation: 'As soon as' এর দুই clause একই সময়ে সংঘটিত হলে দুইটিতেই past indefinite বসে। Principal clause 'opened' (past) — subordinate clause-এ 'heard'।

entries.question_text: He talks as if ____
entries.options_raw: ক) he was mad. খ) he is mad. গ) he were mad. ঘ) he will be mad.
entries.explanation: 'As if/as though' এর পর অবাস্তব তুলনায় subjunctive past ব্যবহৃত হয় — সব person-এর জন্য 'were'। তাই: he were mad.

entries.question_text: He parted _____ his friends in tears.
entries.options_raw: ক) with খ) from গ) against ঘ) beside
entries.explanation: 'Part from someone' = ব্যক্তির কাছ থেকে বিদায় নেওয়া। 'Part with something' = কোনো বস্তু ত্যাগ করা। বন্ধুর কাছ থেকে বিদায় বোঝাতে 'from' যথার্থ।

entries.question_text: Choose the correct sentence ______
entries.options_raw: ক) It rained last night. খ) It rains last night. গ) It will rain last night. ঘ) It rain last night.
entries.explanation: 'Last night' — অতীতের নির্দিষ্ট সময়, তাই past indefinite ('rained') সঠিক।

entries.question_text: 'Get rid of' means ______
entries.options_raw: ক) listen খ) express গ) pretend ঘ) to be free from
entries.explanation: 'Get rid of' phrasal verb — মুক্তি পাওয়া, অবাঞ্ছিত কিছু থেকে রেহাই। যেমন: I want to get rid of this old habit.

entries.question_text: The teacher made the children _____ the book.
entries.options_raw: ক) reading খ) to read গ) read ঘ) reads
entries.explanation: Causative verb 'make/let/bid' + object + bare infinitive (without 'to')। তাই 'The teacher made the children read the book.'

entries.question_text: The word 'homogeneous' means ____
entries.options_raw: ক) dissimilar খ) of the same place গ) of the same density ঘ) of the same kind
entries.explanation: 'Homogeneous' (adj.) — একই ধরনের, সমসত্ত্ব (of the same kind)। বিপরীত 'heterogeneous' — বিভিন্ন ধরনের।

entries.question_text: আমরা বিষয়টি আলোচনা করব।

options.text: We shall discuss about the matter.

options.label: খ
options.text: We shall discuss to the matter.

options.label: গ
options.text: We should discuss on the matter.

entries.options_raw: ক) We shall discuss about the matter. খ) We shall discuss to the matter. গ) We should discuss on the matter. ঘ) We shall discuss the matter.
entries.correct_answer: ঘ) We shall discuss the matter.
entries.explanation: 'Discuss' transitive verb — পরে কোনো preposition বসে না। সরাসরি object আসে। তাই 'discuss the matter' — শুদ্ধ।

entries.question_text: এমন দেশটি কোথাও খুঁজে পাবে নাকো তুমি?

options.label: ক

options.text: Nowhere will you find such a country?

options.label: ঘ
options.text: You will find a country like this nowhere?

entries.options_raw: ক) You will find such a country nowhere? খ) Nowhere you will find such a country? গ) Nowhere will you find such a country? ঘ) You will find a country like this nowhere?
entries.correct_answer: গ) Nowhere will you find such a country?
entries.explanation: বাক্যের শুরুতে negative adverb (nowhere, never, hardly) থাকলে subject-auxiliary inversion হয়। তাই 'Nowhere will you find such a country?' — শুদ্ধ।

entries.question_text: Who is calling me? (Passive)

options.label: ঘ
options.text: By whom am I being called?

entries.options_raw: ক) By whom am I called? খ) By whom I am called? গ) By whom I was called? ঘ) By whom am I being called?
entries.correct_answer: ঘ) By whom am I being called?
entries.explanation: Interrogative subject 'who' + present continuous → passive-এ 'By whom + am/is/are + being + V3?'. Active 'me' → passive subject 'I'। সঠিক: By whom am I being called?

entries.question_text: The roads of Rajshahi are wider ____
entries.options_raw: ক) than those of Dhaka. খ) than Dhaka. গ) than that of Dhaka. ঘ) than Dhaka's roads.
entries.explanation: তুলনায় parallel structure বজায় রাখতে হয়। 'Roads' (plural) → 'those' দিয়ে বোঝাতে হবে। সঠিক: 'wider than those of Dhaka' — অর্থাৎ ঢাকার রাস্তাগুলোর চেয়ে।

entries.question_text: A speech full of too many words is ______
entries.options_raw: ক) A big speech খ) Maiden speech গ) An unimportant speech ঘ) A verbose speech
entries.explanation: 'Verbose' (adj.) — শব্দবহুল, অপ্রয়োজনীয়ভাবে বেশি কথা যুক্ত। 'Maiden speech' = কারো প্রথম বক্তৃতা; verbose speech = বাগবহুল বক্তৃতা।

entries.question_text: Credit Tk. 5,000 _____ my account.
entries.options_raw: ক) with খ) to গ) in ঘ) for
entries.explanation: 'Credit (an amount) to (an account)' — নির্দিষ্ট collocation; কোনো হিসাবে টাকা জমা দেওয়া অর্থে 'to' preposition ব্যবহৃত হয়।

entries.question_text: All love flower. (Interrogative)
entries.options_raw: ক) Who does not love flower? খ) Who do not love flower? গ) Who did not love flower? ঘ) Do all love flower?
entries.correct_answer: ক) Who does not love flower?
entries.explanation: Universal affirmative ('All') → Rhetorical interrogative-এ 'Who does not ...?' গঠন। Interrogative pronoun 'Who' সাধারণত singular verb নেয় → 'does not love'।

entries.question_text: The adjective form of the word 'Study' is ______
entries.options_raw: ক) study খ) studily গ) stupidity ঘ) studious
entries.explanation: 'Study' (noun/verb) → adjective 'studious' (মনোযোগী, অধ্যয়নপ্রিয়)। 'Stupidity' ভিন্ন শব্দ (মূর্খতা)।

entries.explanation: Direct → Indirect: Reporting verb past ('said') হলে past indefinite ('went') → past perfect ('had gone'); pronoun 'I' → 'he'। সঠিক: He said that he had gone to Tangail.

entries.question_text: The verb of the word 'economy' is ______
entries.options_raw: ক) economic খ) economical গ) economically ঘ) economize
entries.explanation: Economy (noun) → Economize (verb, মিতব্যয়ী হওয়া/সাশ্রয় করা); Economic, economical (adj.); Economically (adv.)।

entries.question_text: A person whose head is in the clouds is _____
entries.options_raw: ক) proud খ) a day dreamer গ) an aviator ঘ) useless
entries.explanation: 'Head in the clouds' idiom — অবাস্তব চিন্তায় মগ্ন, দিবাস্বপ্নে ভাসমান ব্যক্তি (day dreamer)।

entries.question_text: শব্দটি কেটে দাও _____
entries.options_raw: ক) Pen through the word. খ) Cut the word. গ) Cut through the word. ঘ) Cut out the word.
entries.explanation: 'Pen through' phrase — কলম দিয়ে দাগ কেটে বাদ দেওয়া, অর্থাৎ 'শব্দটি কেটে দাও'। এটি NTRCA স্বীকৃত idiomatic অনুবাদ।

entries.question_text: Choose the correct sentence:

entries.options_raw: ক) I know what does he want? খ) I know what does he wants? গ) I know what does he want. ঘ) I know what he wants.
entries.correct_answer: ঘ) I know what he wants.
entries.explanation: Indirect question-এ subject-verb ক্রম পরিবর্তন হয় না; সহায়ক 'do/does' ব্যবহৃত হয় না। 'He' third person singular তাই 'wants'।

entries.question_text: Which is the correct use of gerund?

options.label: খ

entries.options_raw: ক) I saw the girl dancing খ) I am dancing on the floor গ) Dancing is a good exercise ঘ) The girl came here dancing
entries.correct_answer: গ) Dancing is a good exercise
entries.explanation: Gerund হলো verb-এর ing form যখন তা noun হিসেবে কাজ করে। "Dancing is a good exercise" — এখানে 'dancing' বাক্যের subject (noun)। অন্যগুলোতে participle হিসেবে কাজ করেছে।

entries.question_text: The correctly spelt word is —
entries.options_raw: ক) Millennium খ) Milennium গ) Milenium ঘ) Millinium
entries.explanation: শুদ্ধ বানান 'Millennium' (double L, double N) — অর্থ সহস্রাব্দ, ১০০০ বছর।

entries.question_text: Which one is a correct sentence?

options.label: খ
options.text: He is a good day than before.

options.label: ঘ
options.text: He is best today than yesterday.

entries.options_raw: ক) He is comparatively better today. খ) He is a good day than before. গ) He is better today. ঘ) He is best today than yesterday.
entries.explanation: 'Better' comparative form — 'more good' নয়। 'He is better today' — সাধারণ ও শুদ্ধ প্রকাশ। 'Comparatively better' বাহুল্য।

entries.question_text: The word 'Homely' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) Noun খ) Adverb গ) Verb ঘ) Adjective
entries.explanation: 'Homely' একটি adjective — অর্থ ঘরোয়া, আরামদায়ক (British: cozy)। '-ly' suffix সবসময় adverb-এর নয়; noun-এ যুক্ত হলে adjective হয় (homely, friendly, lovely, manly)।

entries.question_text: What ___ (do) you do at this moment? — Correct form of verb —
entries.options_raw: ক) do you do খ) doing গ) are you doing ঘ) have done
entries.explanation: 'At this moment' — বর্তমান মুহূর্তে চলমান কাজ; তাই present continuous 'are you doing' বসবে।

entries.question_text: Choose the correct answer:
entries.options_raw: ক) He gave me good-bye. খ) He bade me good-bye. গ) He told me good-bye. ঘ) He wished me good-bye.
entries.explanation: 'Bid good-bye' একটি নির্দিষ্ট collocation — বিদায় জানানো। Bid-এর past 'bade'। "He bade me good-bye" = তিনি আমাকে বিদায় জানালেন।

entries.question_text: The word 'adulteration' can be best explained as —

entries.options_raw: ক) to mix something intensely খ) to use unusual methods গ) to make impure by adding inferior ingredients ঘ) to mix poison
entries.correct_answer: গ) to make impure by adding inferior ingredients
entries.explanation: 'Adulteration' মানে ভেজাল দেওয়া — নিম্নমানের উপাদান মিশিয়ে কোনো কিছুকে অশুদ্ধ করা।

entries.question_text: It is high time we ___ (change) our food habit.
entries.options_raw: ক) changed খ) have changed গ) should have changed ঘ) should change
entries.explanation: 'It is high time' এর পর subject + past simple (subjunctive past) বসে। "It is high time we changed our food habit"।

entries.question_text: Five litres of milk is contained ___ the pot.
entries.options_raw: ক) by খ) to গ) in ঘ) at
entries.explanation: 'Contained in' একটি নির্দিষ্ট collocation — কোনো কিছুর ভেতরে থাকা। "The milk is contained in the pot" — দুধ পটের ভেতরে আছে।

entries.question_text: I could not go ___ for the examination due to rain.
entries.options_raw: ক) in খ) by গ) to ঘ) on
entries.explanation: 'Go in for + something' phrasal verb — কোনো কিছুতে অংশ নেওয়া বা পরীক্ষা দেওয়া। "Go in for the examination" = পরীক্ষায় অংশগ্রহণ করা।

entries.question_text: The phrase 'at loggerheads' means —
entries.options_raw: ক) very close খ) belligerent গ) quarreling ঘ) distant relation
entries.explanation: 'At loggerheads' idiom — বিবাদমান, ঝগড়ায় লিপ্ত। যেমন: They are at loggerheads over the issue.

entries.question_text: Hurry spoils ___ .
entries.options_raw: ক) the work খ) the curry গ) to tarry ঘ) and scary
entries.explanation: 'Hurry spoils the curry' — একটি প্রবাদ; অর্থ তাড়াহুড়ায় কাজ পণ্ড হয়। বাংলা প্রবাদ 'তাড়াহুড়ায় কাজ কাচা'।

entries.question_text: ___ water of this lake is pure.
entries.options_raw: ক) a খ) an or the গ) the ঘ) no article
entries.explanation: 'Water of this lake' — এখানে নির্দিষ্ট লেকের পানি বোঝানো হয়েছে; নির্দিষ্টতার জন্য definite article 'the' বসে। "The water of this lake is pure"।

entries.question_text: I wanted the poster ___ .
entries.options_raw: ক) hang খ) to be hanged গ) to be hunged ঘ) to be hung
entries.explanation: 'Hang' এর দুই past-participle — 'hanged' (মৃত্যুদণ্ড দেওয়া) ও 'hung' (বস্তু ঝোলানো)। পোস্টার ঝোলানো অর্থে 'hung'। "I wanted the poster to be hung"।

entries.question_text: 'Leave no stone unturned' means —
entries.options_raw: ক) heavy stone খ) impossible গ) rare stone ঘ) try every possible means
entries.explanation: 'Leave no stone unturned' idiom — সব চেষ্টা করা, কোনো সম্ভাব্য উপায় বাদ না দেওয়া। বাংলা: তন্ন তন্ন করে খুঁজে দেখা / প্রাণপণ চেষ্টা করা।

entries.question_text: Would you mind ___ me a cup of tea?
entries.options_raw: ক) giving খ) make গ) bringing ঘ) bring
entries.explanation: 'Would you mind' এর পর verb-এর ing form (gerund) বসে। "Would you mind giving me a cup of tea?"।

entries.question_text: What is the antonym of 'rear'?
entries.options_raw: ক) Not available খ) Behind গ) Front ঘ) Available
entries.explanation: 'Rear' মানে পিছন, পশ্চাৎ। বিপরীত 'front' — সামনে। 'Behind' এর সমার্থক।

entries.question_text: 'ছেলেটি কাঁদতে কাঁদতে আমার কাছে এল।'

entries.options_raw: ক) The boy came to me crying. খ) The boy came near me crying. গ) The boy came to me in crying. ঘ) The boy came to me by crying.
entries.correct_answer: ক) The boy came to me crying.
entries.explanation: 'কাঁদতে কাঁদতে' ভাব প্রকাশে present participle (crying) ব্যবহৃত হয়। "The boy came to me crying" — শুদ্ধ অনুবাদ।

entries.question_text: 'Had I riches, I ___ (help) you.'
entries.options_raw: ক) would helped খ) would have helped গ) had helped ঘ) will help
entries.explanation: NTRCA কর্তৃপক্ষ প্রশ্নটি বাতিল করেছে। ('Had I riches' — বর্তমানের কল্পনা হলে 'would help'; অতীতের হলে 'would have helped' — কোন অর্থ অভিপ্রেত তা অস্পষ্ট।)

entries.question_text: What is the appropriate meaning of 'Achilles heel'?
entries.options_raw: ক) Important issue খ) Turning Point গ) Vulnerable Point ঘ) Main point
entries.explanation: 'Achilles heel' idiom — কোনো ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুর দুর্বল দিক (vulnerable point)। গ্রীক পুরাণে অ্যাকিলিস অজেয় ছিলেন, শুধু গোড়ালি ছাড়া — যেখানে আঘাত করেই তাকে মারা হয়।

entries.question_text: 'লেবু কচলালে তেতো হয়' — The best translation is —

options.label: ক
options.text: The lemon becomes bitter if it is rubbed.

options.label: খ
options.text: A jest driven hard, loses its points.

options.label: গ
options.text: A hungry fox is an angry fox.

options.label: ঘ
options.text: Don't try to do anything again and again.

entries.options_raw: ক) The lemon becomes bitter if it is rubbed. খ) A jest driven hard, loses its points. গ) A hungry fox is an angry fox. ঘ) Don't try to do anything again and again.
entries.correct_answer: খ) A jest driven hard, loses its points.
entries.explanation: 'A jest driven hard, loses its points' — একই কৌতুক বারবার করলে তার মজা নষ্ট হয়ে যায়। বাংলা প্রবাদ 'লেবু কচলালে তেতো হয়' এর সমার্থক অনুবাদ।

entries.question_text: Which one below is a correct sentence?

options.label: গ
options.text: It is I who is to blame.

options.label: ঘ
options.text: The girl resembles to her mother.

entries.options_raw: ক) They have seen me yesterday. খ) I like his childlike simplicity. গ) It is I who is to blame. ঘ) The girl resembles to her mother.
entries.correct_answer: খ) I like his childlike simplicity.
entries.explanation: 'Childlike' মানে শিশুসুলভ (positive)। অপশন ক: 'have seen' + yesterday একসাথে ভুল (past indefinite দরকার); গ: 'It is I who am to blame' (agreement); ঘ: 'resemble' এর পর preposition বসে না।

entries.question_text: At the scene, ___ mother arose in her.
entries.options_raw: ক) a খ) the গ) a or the ঘ) no article
entries.explanation: এখানে 'mother' একটি বিশেষ প্রবৃত্তি বা অনুভূতি বোঝাচ্ছে (মাতৃত্বসুলভ ভাব)। বিশেষ গুণ/অনুভূতির পূর্বে definite article 'the' বসে। "The mother arose in her" — মাতৃত্বের অনুভূতি জেগে উঠল।

entries.question_text: What is the verb form of the word 'friend'?
entries.options_raw: ক) friend খ) friended গ) friending ঘ) befriend
entries.explanation: Friend (noun) → Befriend (verb) — বন্ধুত্ব স্থাপন করা। 'Be-' একটি productive prefix, যা noun/adj-কে verb-এ পরিণত করে (befriend, belittle, becalm)।

entries.question_text: 'মানবজাতি এখন সংকটাপন্ন।'

options.label: ক
options.text: Mankind are at a stake now.

entries.options_raw: ক) Mankind are at a stake now. খ) Mankind are at stake now. গ) Mankind is at stake now. ঘ) Men are at stake now.
entries.correct_answer: গ) Mankind is at stake now.
entries.explanation: 'Mankind' একটি সমষ্টিবাচক singular noun; তাই singular verb 'is' বসবে। 'At stake' idiom = সংকটাপন্ন। Complete: Mankind is at stake now.

entries.question_text: 'তার কোনো বন্ধু নাই বললেই চলে।'

options.label: ঘ
options.text: He does not have any friends.

entries.options_raw: ক) He has no friends. খ) He has a few friends. গ) He has few friends. ঘ) He does not have any friends.
entries.explanation: 'Few' (article ছাড়া) = প্রায় কেউ নেই — নেতিবাচক ভাব; 'a few' = কিছু আছে (ইতিবাচক)। "নাই বললেই চলে" ভাব 'few' দিয়ে প্রকাশ পায়।

entries.question_text: 'বিনয় মহত্ত্বের ভূষণ।'

options.label: ক
options.text: Modesty is the embellishment of greatness.

entries.options_raw: ক) Modesty is the embellishment of greatness. খ) Modesty is greatness. গ) Modesty is great embellishment. ঘ) Modesty is embellishment to greatness.
entries.correct_answer: ক) Modesty is the embellishment of greatness.
entries.explanation: 'বিনয়' = Modesty; 'মহত্ত্বের ভূষণ' = the embellishment of greatness। 'Of + noun' গঠন সম্পর্কসূচক genitive প্রকাশ করে।

entries.question_text: What is the antonym of 'agile'?
entries.options_raw: ক) active খ) nimble গ) lively ঘ) lazy
entries.explanation: 'Agile' মানে চটপটে, ক্ষিপ্র। বিপরীত 'lazy' — অলস। Active, nimble, lively — এর সমার্থক।

entries.question_text: The antonym of 'optimism' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) Pessimism খ) Opportunities গ) Pestilence ঘ) Opulence
entries.explanation: Optimism = আশাবাদ; বিপরীত Pessimism = হতাশাবাদ, নৈরাশ্যবাদ। Pestilence = মহামারী; Opulence = ঐশ্বর্য।

entries.question_text: What is the synonym of 'alliance'?
entries.options_raw: ক) Enmity খ) Alien গ) Association ঘ) Separation
entries.explanation: Alliance = জোট, মৈত্রী; সমার্থক 'Association' (সমিতি, সংঘ)। Enmity ও separation এর বিপরীত।

entries.question_text: The synonym of 'annihilate' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) restore খ) preserve গ) safe ঘ) destroy
entries.explanation: Annihilate = সম্পূর্ণ ধ্বংস করা, নিশ্চিহ্ন করা। সমার্থক 'destroy' — ধ্বংস করা।

entries.question_text: Verb form of 'false' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) falsify খ) falsely গ) falsification ঘ) falcify
entries.explanation: False (adj.) → Falsify (verb) — মিথ্যা প্রমাণ করা, বিকৃত করা। Falsely (adv.); Falsification (noun)।

entries.question_text: Adverb form of 'heart' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) heartened খ) heartily গ) hearty ঘ) heartening
entries.explanation: Heart (noun) → Heartily (adverb) — আন্তরিকভাবে, মন থেকে। Hearty (adj.) — উষ্ণ, প্রাণবন্ত।

entries.question_text: Adjective form of 'courage' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) encourage খ) courageous গ) curiosity ঘ) courageable
entries.explanation: Courage (noun) → Courageous (adj.) — সাহসী। Encourage (verb) — উৎসাহিত করা।

entries.question_text: What is the verb form of 'ability'?
entries.options_raw: ক) ableness খ) enable গ) ably ঘ) able
entries.explanation: Ability (noun) → Enable (verb) — সক্ষম করা। Able (adj.); Ably (adv.)।

entries.question_text: It's time you ___ your mistakes.
entries.options_raw: ক) realised খ) realise গ) had realised ঘ) have realised
entries.explanation: 'It's time' এর পর subject + past simple (subjunctive past) বসে। "It's time you realised your mistakes"।

entries.question_text: Jamal walks as if he ___ lame.
entries.options_raw: ক) is খ) has been গ) were ঘ) was
entries.explanation: 'As if / as though' এর পর subjunctive mood-এ 'were' বসে (সব person-এর জন্য) — অবাস্তব/কাল্পনিক তুলনা প্রকাশে।

entries.question_text: Uneasy lies the head that ___ a crown.
entries.options_raw: ক) wear খ) wears গ) puts ঘ) keep
entries.explanation: Shakespeare-এর উক্তি "Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown"। Subject 'the head' (third person singular), তাই 'wears'।

entries.question_text: Read diligently lest you ___ fail in the examination.
entries.options_raw: ক) should খ) will গ) shall ঘ) must
entries.explanation: 'Lest' (পাছে) এর পর subject + should + base verb বসে। "Read diligently lest you should fail"।

entries.question_text: He ___ me while I was reading.
entries.options_raw: ক) interrupts খ) interrupted গ) is interrupting ঘ) interrupting
entries.explanation: 'While' যুক্ত ও অপর অংশ past continuous ('was reading') হলে সংযুক্ত অংশে past simple ('interrupted') বসে।

entries.question_text: Corruption is one of the worst evils. (Positive)

options.label: ক

options.label: খ
options.text: No other evil are as bad as corruption.

options.label: গ
options.text: No other evil is as bad as corruption.

options.label: ঘ
options.text: Very few evils are as bad as corruption.

entries.options_raw: ক) Very few evils is as bad as corruption. খ) No other evil are as bad as corruption. গ) No other evil is as bad as corruption. ঘ) Very few evils are as bad as corruption.
entries.correct_answer: ঘ) Very few evils are as bad as corruption.
entries.explanation: 'One of the + superlative' → Positive-এ 'Very few + plural noun + are + as + positive + as + subject' গঠন হয়।

entries.question_text: We should read books to gain knowledge. (Make it complex)

options.label: খ

options.text: We want to gain knowledge and so we should read books.

entries.correct_answer: গ) We should read books so that we can gain knowledge.
entries.explanation: Purpose (উদ্দেশ্য) বোঝাতে 'to + verb' → 'so that + subject + can/may + verb' গঠনে রূপান্তর।

entries.question_text: 'Please, keep quiet.' (Make it passive)

options.label: ক
options.text: You are told for keeping quiet.

options.label: খ
options.text: You are requested to keep quiet.

options.label: গ
options.text: You are requested for keep quiet.

options.label: ঘ
options.text: You are told to keep quiet.

entries.options_raw: ক) You are told for keeping quiet. খ) You are requested to keep quiet. গ) You are requested for keep quiet. ঘ) You are told to keep quiet.
entries.correct_answer: খ) You are requested to keep quiet.
entries.explanation: 'Please' যুক্ত polite request-এর passive-এ 'You are requested to + base verb' বসে।

entries.question_text: Trees are considered one of our best friends. (Make it active)

options.label: ক
options.text: It is tree which is our best friend.

options.label: গ
options.text: We considered trees one of our best friends.

options.label: ঘ
options.text: We consider trees one of our best friend.

entries.options_raw: ক) It is tree which is our best friend. খ) Trees are our best friends. গ) We considered trees one of our best friends. ঘ) We consider trees one of our best friend.
entries.correct_answer: খ) Trees are our best friends.
entries.explanation: Passive 'Trees are considered our best friends' এর active NTRCA-স্বীকৃত রূপ 'Trees are our best friends' — সরলীকৃত (ঐতিহাসিক বাক্যরূপে)।

entries.question_text: Cricket is a very exciting game. (Make it Exclamatory)

options.label: ক
options.text: Hurrah! cricket is an exciting game.

options.label: গ
options.text: How exciting is cricket when it plays!

options.label: ঘ
options.text: What an exciting game cricket is!

entries.options_raw: ক) Hurrah! cricket is an exciting game. খ) How exciting game is cricket! গ) How exciting is cricket when it plays! ঘ) What an exciting game cricket is!
entries.correct_answer: ঘ) What an exciting game cricket is!
entries.explanation: 'A + adjective + noun' গঠনে exclamatory-তে 'What a/an + adj + noun + subject + verb!' — "What an exciting game cricket is!"।

entries.question_text: The word 'Banish' means —
entries.options_raw: ক) exile খ) emerge গ) drive away ঘ) expel
entries.explanation: 'Banish' মানে নির্বাসন দেওয়া, দেশ থেকে বহিষ্কার করা। সমার্থক 'exile'। 'Expel' ও 'drive away' কাছাকাছি অর্থ বহন করলেও 'exile' সবচেয়ে যথাযথ।

entries.question_text: 'A cock and bull story' means —

options.label: খ
options.text: a story about a cock and a bull

entries.options_raw: ক) an animal story খ) a story about a cock and a bull গ) a tragedy ঘ) a false story
entries.explanation: 'A cock and bull story' idiom — অবিশ্বাস্য/মনগড়া/মিথ্যা গল্প (a far-fetched, unbelievable story)।

entries.question_text: 'Big bug' means —
entries.options_raw: ক) terrorist খ) a large bug গ) important person ঘ) a large insect
entries.explanation: 'Big bug' informal idiom — গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ব্যক্তি, VIP, প্রভাবশালী লোক (big shot)।

entries.question_text: 'At a stretch' means —
entries.options_raw: ক) without break খ) stretch mark গ) long way ঘ) decay
entries.explanation: 'At a stretch' idiom — একটানা, কোনো বিরতি ছাড়া (continuously, without a break)। যেমন: He worked for six hours at a stretch.

entries.question_text: He tried his best. (Negative)

options.label: ক
options.text: He did not try a little

options.label: ঘ
options.text: He did not turn all stones.

entries.options_raw: ক) He did not try a little খ) He did not stay unmoved গ) He left no stone unturned ঘ) He did not turn all stones.
entries.correct_answer: গ) He left no stone unturned
entries.explanation: "He tried his best" এর negative রূপান্তরে 'Leave no stone unturned' idiom ব্যবহার করা হয় — সব চেষ্টা করা। "He left no stone unturned" = তিনি চেষ্টার কোনো ত্রুটি রাখেননি।

entries.question_text: She was used to ___ the poor.
entries.options_raw: ক) help খ) helped গ) helping ঘ) to help
entries.explanation: 'Be used to' + gerund (verb + ing) — অভ্যস্ত থাকা অর্থে। 'to' এখানে preposition, তাই পরে verb-ing। Complete: She was used to helping the poor.

entries.question_text: Which is the noun of the word 'brief'?
entries.options_raw: ক) briefly খ) brevity গ) brieve ঘ) but
entries.explanation: Brief (adj., short) → Brevity (noun, shortness/conciseness)। Briefly (adv.)। উক্তি: "Brevity is the soul of wit"।

entries.question_text: It was high time we ___ our habits.
entries.options_raw: ক) changed খ) change গ) had changed ঘ) should change
entries.explanation: 'It is/was high time' এর পর subject + past simple (subjunctive past) বসে — যদিও অর্থগতভাবে বর্তমান কালীন। তাই 'changed'।

entries.question_text: Curd is made ___ milk.
entries.options_raw: ক) of খ) by গ) in ঘ) from
entries.explanation: যখন কোনো বস্তু থেকে অন্য বস্তু এমনভাবে তৈরি হয় যে মূল বস্তুটি চেনা যায় না, তখন 'from' ব্যবহৃত হয়। Ex: Butter is made from milk; Wine is made from grapes।

entries.question_text: The Headmaster and the President of the school ___ present in the last meeting.
entries.options_raw: ক) was খ) were গ) had been ঘ) have been
entries.explanation: দুইজন ভিন্ন ব্যক্তি (আলাদা 'the') যুক্ত হলে plural subject, তাই plural verb 'were'। সময় 'last meeting' — past tense।

entries.question_text: If he ___ a human being, he would not have done this.
entries.options_raw: ক) is খ) was গ) had been ঘ) were
entries.explanation: Third conditional structure: If + past perfect (had been), main clause + would have + V3। Main clause 'would not have done' → if-clause 'had been'।

entries.question_text: The antonym of the word 'benign' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) tenfold খ) peaceful গ) blessed ঘ) malignant
entries.explanation: 'Benign' মানে দয়ালু, নিরীহ, ভালো প্রকৃতির (কোনো টিউমার হলে ক্ষতিকর নয়)। বিপরীত 'malignant' — ক্ষতিকর, দূষিত, ক্যান্সারযুক্ত।

entries.question_text: Do not ___ what you can do today.
entries.options_raw: ক) put on খ) put to গ) put off ঘ) put left
entries.explanation: 'Put off' phrasal verb — স্থগিত/মুলতবি রাখা (postpone)। বিখ্যাত প্রবাদ: "Do not put off till tomorrow what you can do today" — আজকের কাজ কাল করো না।

entries.question_text: They tell us a tale about a tail. The word 'tale' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) noun খ) verb গ) adjective ঘ) adverb
entries.explanation: 'Tale' মানে গল্প — বাক্যে 'a tale' object হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত, তাই noun। ('Tail' এখানে homophone — লেজ, তাও noun।)

entries.question_text: Move or die. (Simple)

options.label: ক
options.text: In case of your failure to move, you will die

options.label: গ
options.text: If you move, you will die

entries.options_raw: ক) In case of your failure to move, you will die খ) You move, you will die গ) If you move, you will die ঘ) Move and die
entries.correct_answer: ক) In case of your failure to move, you will die
entries.explanation: Imperative 'or'-যুক্ত compound sentence-কে simple-এ রূপান্তরে 'in case of failure to...' phrase-বাঞ্চক নির্মাণ ব্যবহৃত হয়। এখানে 'or'-এর নেতিবাচক শর্ত (failure to move) বোঝায়।

entries.question_text: Which one is correct?
entries.options_raw: ক) Omnious খ) Extencion গ) Hesitasion ঘ) Mischievous
entries.explanation: শুদ্ধ বানান 'Mischievous' (adj. — দুষ্টু)। অন্যদের শুদ্ধ রূপ: Ominous, Extension, Hesitation।

entries.question_text: The opposite word of 'sluggish' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) animated খ) dull গ) heavy ঘ) slow
entries.explanation: 'Sluggish' মানে ধীর, নিস্তেজ, অলস। বিপরীত 'animated' — প্রাণবন্ত, সজীব। Dull ও slow এর সমার্থক।

entries.question_text: I saw him play. (Passive)

options.label: ক
options.text: He was seen by me play.

options.label: খ
options.text: Play was seen him by me.

options.label: গ
options.text: He was seen playing by me.

options.label: ঘ
options.text: He was seen to play by me.

entries.options_raw: ক) He was seen by me play. খ) Play was seen him by me. গ) He was seen playing by me. ঘ) He was seen to play by me.
entries.correct_answer: ঘ) He was seen to play by me.
entries.explanation: Sensory verb (see, hear) + object + bare infinitive → passive-এ 'be + V3 + to + infinitive' গঠন হয়। I saw him play → He was seen to play by me।

entries.question_text: 'Bootleg' means to —
entries.options_raw: ক) distribute খ) export গ) import ঘ) smuggle
entries.explanation: 'Bootleg' verb-এর অর্থ চোরাচালান বা অবৈধ পথে দ্রব্য কেনাবেচা করা (to smuggle, especially alcohol during prohibition)।

entries.question_text: While I ___ (play) in the field, I saw a dead cow.
entries.options_raw: ক) playing খ) was playing গ) played ঘ) were playing
entries.explanation: 'While' যুক্ত ও অপর অংশ past indefinite ('saw') হলে while-clause-এ past continuous ('was playing') বসে।

entries.question_text: But for your help I ___
entries.options_raw: ক) would have failed খ) would fail গ) will fail ঘ) will have failed
entries.explanation: 'But for' = "If not for" — past-এর হাইপোথেটিক্যাল অবস্থা প্রকাশ করে; main clause-এ 'would have + V3' বসে। অর্থাৎ, তোমার সাহায্য না থাকলে আমি ফেল করতাম।

entries.question_text: Choose the correct sentence:

options.label: ক
options.text: He had been hanged for murder.

options.label: খ
options.text: He has been hunged for murder.

entries.options_raw: ক) He had been hanged for murder. খ) He has been hunged for murder. গ) He was hanged for murder. ঘ) He was hunged for murder.
entries.correct_answer: গ) He was hanged for murder.
entries.explanation: 'Hang'-এর past ও past participle দুই রূপ — মৃত্যুদণ্ড অর্থে 'hanged, hanged' (regular); বস্তু ঝোলানো অর্থে 'hung, hung'। মৃত্যুদণ্ড-এ 'was hanged' সঠিক।

options.label: ক
options.text: I went there and seeked a job.

options.label: খ
options.text: I went there so that I could seek a job.

options.label: গ
options.text: I went there for seeking a job.

options.label: ঘ
options.text: I went there and sought a job.

entries.options_raw: ক) I went there and seeked a job. খ) I went there so that I could seek a job. গ) I went there for seeking a job. ঘ) I went there and sought a job.
entries.correct_answer: ঘ) I went there and sought a job.
entries.explanation: Simple to Compound — infinitive of purpose ('to seek') কে 'and + V (past)' দিয়ে রূপান্তর করা হয়। 'Seek'-এর past 'sought' (irregular)। অপশন ক ভুল — 'seeked' নয়।

entries.question_text: Instead of 'confirm' we can say —
entries.options_raw: ক) bear out খ) bear on গ) bear to ঘ) bear of
entries.explanation: 'Bear out' phrasal verb — নিশ্চিত করা, সমর্থন করা (to confirm/support)। যেমন: The facts bear out my statement।

entries.question_text: What is the antonym of 'Abduct'?
entries.options_raw: ক) Take away unlawfully খ) Kidnap গ) Restore ঘ) None of them
entries.explanation: 'Abduct' মানে অপহরণ করা। বিপরীত 'Restore' — ফিরিয়ে দেওয়া, পুনঃস্থাপন করা। Kidnap ও 'take away unlawfully' এর সমার্থক।

entries.question_text: The father with his seven daughters ___ left the house.
entries.options_raw: ক) have খ) are গ) has ঘ) was
entries.explanation: 'With'/'along with'/'as well as' যুক্ত phrase দ্বারা সংযোজিত noun বাক্যের subject-এর সংখ্যা পরিবর্তন করে না। এখানে main subject 'The father' — singular, তাই 'has left'।

entries.question_text: She has no taste ___ music.
entries.options_raw: ক) of খ) for গ) to ঘ) in
entries.explanation: 'Taste for something' একটি নির্দিষ্ট collocation — কোনো কিছুর প্রতি রুচি বা আগ্রহ। যেমন: He has a taste for classical music.

entries.question_text: 'কর্তৃপক্ষ তাকে তিরস্কার করলো।'

options.label: খ
options.text: The authority took him to task.

options.label: গ
options.text: The authority took him to book.

options.label: ঘ
options.text: The authority gave reins to him.

entries.correct_answer: খ) The authority took him to task.
entries.explanation: 'Take someone to task' idiom — কঠোরভাবে তিরস্কার/জিজ্ঞাসাবাদ করা। 'Take to book' = জবাবদিহি করানো; 'give reins' = স্বাধীনতা দেওয়া।

options.label: খ

options.label: গ
options.text: He lived in a hut close to the river.

options.label: ঘ
options.text: He lived in a hut close by the river.

entries.options_raw: ক) He lived a hut close with river. খ) He lived in a hut close at the river. গ) He lived in a hut close to the river. ঘ) He lived in a hut close by the river.
entries.correct_answer: ঘ) He lived in a hut close by the river.
entries.explanation: 'Close by' একটি নির্দিষ্ট phrase — কোনো কিছুর ঠিক পাশে/নিকটে। 'Close to' ও 'close by' অর্থগতভাবে কাছাকাছি; NTRCA স্বীকৃত উত্তর 'close by'।

entries.question_text: 'I know you.' Choose the complex form —
entries.options_raw: ক) I know what you are. খ) I know who you are. গ) I know what are you. ঘ) I know who are you.
entries.correct_answer: খ) I know who you are.
entries.explanation: Simple → Complex-এ noun-object কে noun-clause বানানো হয়। 'You' ব্যক্তি বোঝায় বলে 'who'; indirect question — subject-verb ক্রম পরিবর্তিত হয় না।

entries.question_text: ___ course of time, he became a famous writer.
entries.options_raw: ক) In খ) Of গ) For ঘ) By
entries.explanation: 'In course of time' একটি নির্দিষ্ট idiom — অর্থ সময়ের সাথে সাথে, ধীরে ধীরে (over time)।

entries.question_text: ___ ink in my pen is red.
entries.options_raw: ক) A খ) The গ) An ঘ) No article
entries.explanation: 'Ink in my pen' — নির্দিষ্ট কলমের ভিতরের নির্দিষ্ট কালি বোঝায়। নির্দিষ্ট বস্তু বোঝাতে definite article 'the' বসে।

entries.question_text: Complete the sentence: Poly ran fast lest she ___ miss the class.
entries.options_raw: ক) could খ) would গ) can ঘ) should
entries.explanation: 'Lest' (পাছে) এর পরে সবসময় 'should + base verb' বসে। যেমন: Study attentively lest you should fail.

entries.question_text: Which one is correct?

options.text: There is no place for doubt in it.

options.label: খ
options.text: There is no space for doubt in it.

options.label: গ
options.text: There is no room for doubt in it.

options.label: ঘ
options.text: There is no area to doubt in it.

entries.options_raw: ক) There is no place for doubt in it. খ) There is no space for doubt in it. গ) There is no room for doubt in it. ঘ) There is no area to doubt in it.
entries.correct_answer: গ) There is no room for doubt in it.
entries.explanation: 'Room for something' একটি নির্দিষ্ট idiomatic collocation — অর্থ কোনো সুযোগ বা অবকাশ। "No room for doubt" = সন্দেহের কোনো অবকাশ নেই।

entries.question_text: Which one is the correct English translation of 'অসারের তর্জন গর্জন সার'?
entries.options_raw: ক) Ignorance is vociferous. খ) An idle man speaks much. গ) A barking dog seldom bites. ঘ) An empty vessel sounds much.
entries.correct_answer: ঘ) An empty vessel sounds much.
entries.explanation: 'অসারের তর্জন গর্জন সার' = যার ভেতরে কিছু নেই সে বেশি বকবক করে। এর ইংরেজি প্রবাদ 'An empty vessel sounds much' (or 'makes the most noise')।

entries.question_text: The doctor will come back to the ward in no time. The underlined phrase means —
entries.options_raw: ক) instantly খ) hardly গ) always ঘ) never
entries.explanation: 'In no time' idiom — খুব দ্রুত, তৎক্ষণাৎ (instantly, very quickly)।

entries.question_text: The memoranda ___ not important.
entries.options_raw: ক) is খ) has গ) have ঘ) are
entries.explanation: 'Memoranda' plural (singular 'memorandum'), তাই plural verb 'are' বসবে।

entries.question_text: The word 'decade' refers to —
entries.options_raw: ক) thirty years খ) fifty years গ) ten years ঘ) twenty five years
entries.explanation: Decade = ১০ বছরের সময়কাল (দশক)। Century = ১০০ বছর; Millennium = ১০০০ বছর।

entries.question_text: No spelling error occurs in —
entries.options_raw: ক) extravagant খ) pronounciation গ) spureous ঘ) temporery
entries.explanation: 'Extravagant' শুদ্ধ বানান (অর্থ: অপরিমিত ব্যয়বহুল)। অন্যগুলোর শুদ্ধ রূপ: pronunciation, spurious, temporary।

entries.question_text: None but ___ brave deserve ___ fair.
entries.options_raw: ক) a, an খ) the, the গ) the, no article ঘ) no article, the
entries.explanation: বিশেষণ পূর্বে 'the' যোগ করলে সেটি বিশেষ্যপদে (শ্রেণিবাচক) পরিণত হয় — 'the brave' = the brave people; 'the fair' = the fair women। "None but the brave deserve the fair" একটি বিখ্যাত quotation।

entries.question_text: If you help me, I ___ grateful.
entries.options_raw: ক) will be remain খ) should remain গ) will remain ঘ) would remain
entries.explanation: First conditional (real condition) — If + present simple, subject + will + base verb। "If you help me, I will remain grateful"।

entries.question_text: Which is the correct form of Assertive of 'Who does not like a rose?'

options.label: ক
options.text: All of us likes a rose.

entries.options_raw: ক) All of us likes a rose. খ) Nobody likes a rose. গ) Everyone dislikes a rose. ঘ) Everyone likes a rose.
entries.explanation: 'Who does not + verb?' — negative interrogative। Assertive-এ 'Everyone + verb' — অর্থ সবাই এটি পছন্দ করে।

entries.question_text: Had you walked fast, you ___ the train. The correct form of verb will be —
entries.options_raw: ক) will not miss খ) will not have missed গ) would not have missed ঘ) would not miss
entries.explanation: Third conditional inverted form: 'Had + subject + V3, subject + would/could/might have + V3'। "Had you walked fast, you would not have missed the train"।

options.label: গ
options.text: The tree has not caught any fruit.

options.label: ঘ
options.text: The tree has not yet borne fruit.

entries.options_raw: ক) The tree can not bear fruit. খ) The tree has not given fruit yet. গ) The tree has not caught any fruit. ঘ) The tree has not yet borne fruit.
entries.correct_answer: ঘ) The tree has not yet borne fruit.
entries.explanation: গাছের ফল ধরাকে বলে 'bear fruit' (past participle: borne)। Present perfect (has not borne) এখনো না ঘটার ভাব প্রকাশ করে। Complete: The tree has not yet borne fruit.

entries.question_text: The word 'heritage' refers to —
entries.options_raw: ক) heir খ) tradition গ) legitimacy ঘ) intrigue
entries.explanation: Heritage = ঐতিহ্য, উত্তরাধিকারসূত্রে প্রাপ্ত সংস্কৃতি/সম্পদ (tradition, inheritance)।

entries.question_text: The price of mango is high in our country. ___ we turn this land into a mango orchard?
entries.options_raw: ক) as if খ) would rather গ) what's it like ঘ) what if
entries.explanation: 'What if' — কী হয় যদি...; কল্পিত প্রস্তাব বা সম্ভাবনা প্রকাশ করে। "What if we turn this land into a mango orchard?" — আমরা যদি এই জমিটাকে আমবাগানে পরিণত করি তাহলে কেমন হয়?

entries.question_text: Ignorance is obstacle ___ progress.
entries.options_raw: ক) to খ) for গ) with ঘ) from
entries.explanation: 'Obstacle to something' একটি নির্দিষ্ট collocation — কোনো কিছুতে বাধা। যেমন: Ignorance is an obstacle to progress.

entries.question_text: 'Very few insects are as busy as a bee.' The correct comparative form of the sentence is —

options.text: A bee is busier than very few insects.

options.text: A bee is busier than few insects.

options.label: গ
options.text: A bee is busier than most other insects.

options.label: ঘ
options.text: A bee is more busy than other insects.

entries.options_raw: ক) A bee is busier than very few insects. খ) A bee is busier than few insects. গ) A bee is busier than most other insects. ঘ) A bee is more busy than other insects.
entries.correct_answer: গ) A bee is busier than most other insects.
entries.explanation: 'Very few + noun + verb + as + positive + as' → Comparative-এ 'subject + comparative + than + most other + noun' গঠন।

entries.question_text: 'Fifty miles ___ not a long distance.'
entries.options_raw: ক) are খ) is গ) have been ঘ) were
entries.explanation: দূরত্ব/সময়/অর্থ বোঝানো plural noun-কে singular subject ধরা হয়। "Fifty miles is not a long distance" — ৫০ মাইল দীর্ঘ পথ নয়।

entries.question_text: 'He came home yesterday.' Choose the correct interrogative form —

entries.explanation: Simple past-এর interrogative গঠন: Did + subject + base verb + ... ? "Did he come home yesterday?" — শুদ্ধ। (অপশন খ ভুল: 'came' না, 'come' বসবে।)

entries.explanation: 'As you sow, so you reap' — যেমন কর্ম তেমন ফল; যা বপন করবে, তাই কাটবে। বাইবেলের গালাতীয় ৬:৭ থেকে উদ্ভূত প্রবাদ।

entries.correct_answer: ক) I will avail myself of the opportunity.
entries.explanation: 'Avail oneself of something' একটি নির্দিষ্ট গঠন — অর্থ কোনো সুযোগ কাজে লাগানো। Reflexive pronoun ('myself') + preposition 'of' বাধ্যতামূলক।

entries.question_text: The antonym of 'vice' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) honesty খ) values গ) virtue ঘ) truthful
entries.explanation: Vice = দোষ, অপকর্ম, নৈতিক দূষণ। এর বিপরীত 'virtue' — গুণ, সদ্গুণ, নৈতিক শ্রেষ্ঠত্ব।

options.label: গ
options.text: Faults are counted where there is no love.

options.text: Faults are many where love is little.

entries.correct_answer: খ) Faults are thick where love is thin.
entries.explanation: বাংলা প্রবাদটির স্বীকৃত ইংরেজি প্রবচন — "Faults are thick where love is thin"। অর্থাৎ ভালোবাসা কম থাকলেই দোষ বেশি চোখে পড়ে।

entries.question_text: 'তুমি কি জানো সে কোথায় থাকে?'

options.label: ক
options.text: Do you know where does he live?

options.label: খ
options.text: Do you know where does he lives?

options.label: গ
options.text: Do you know where he lives?

options.label: ঘ
options.text: Do you know where he live?

entries.options_raw: ক) Do you know where does he live? খ) Do you know where does he lives? গ) Do you know where he lives? ঘ) Do you know where he live?
entries.correct_answer: গ) Do you know where he lives?
entries.explanation: Indirect question — Wh-clause-এর subject-verb ক্রম পরিবর্তন হয় না, auxiliary 'do/does' লাগে না। 'He' third person singular হওয়ায় 'lives'।

entries.question_text: 'আজ বৃষ্টি হতে পারে।'
entries.options_raw: ক) Today will rain. খ) It should be raining today. গ) It may rain today. ঘ) Today is raining.
entries.explanation: সম্ভাবনা বোঝাতে modal 'may' ব্যবহৃত হয়। 'It may rain today' = আজ বৃষ্টি হতে পারে।

entries.question_text: What is the antonym of 'transparent'?
entries.options_raw: ক) Transform খ) Lubricant গ) Pure ঘ) Hazy
entries.explanation: 'Transparent' মানে স্বচ্ছ, ভেদ্য; বিপরীত 'hazy' (অস্পষ্ট, ধোঁয়াশাপূর্ণ)।

entries.question_text: The synonym of 'Prestige' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) status খ) state গ) prestigious ঘ) static
entries.explanation: 'Prestige' (মর্যাদা, সম্মান) এর সমার্থক 'status' (সামাজিক অবস্থান, মর্যাদা)।

entries.question_text: What is the antonym of 'antagonistic'?
entries.options_raw: ক) Unfriendly খ) Friendly গ) Hostile ঘ) Trivial
entries.explanation: 'Antagonistic' মানে বৈরী, শত্রুভাবাপন্ন। এর বিপরীত 'friendly' (বন্ধুত্বপূর্ণ)। Unfriendly ও hostile এর সমার্থক।

entries.question_text: What is the adjective of 'Laud'?
entries.options_raw: ক) Laudable খ) Laudful গ) Laudy ঘ) Lauded
entries.explanation: Laud (verb) — প্রশংসা করা; Laudable (adj.) — প্রশংসনীয়। Laudably (adv.); Laudation (noun)।

entries.question_text: What is the verb form of 'Popularity'?
entries.options_raw: ক) Popular খ) Popularly গ) Population ঘ) Popularize
entries.explanation: Popularity (noun) → Popularize (verb) — জনপ্রিয় করা। Popular (adj.); Popularly (adv.)।

entries.question_text: Noun form of 'blind' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) blind খ) blindly গ) blindness ঘ) blindy
entries.explanation: Blind (adj.) → Blindness (noun) — অন্ধত্ব। Blindly (adv.)।

entries.question_text: I will not go out if it ___ .
entries.options_raw: ক) rain খ) rains গ) is raining ঘ) would be raining
entries.explanation: First conditional structure — If + present simple, subject + will + base verb। 'It' third person singular তাই 'rains'।

entries.question_text: One of the boys ___ absent yesterday.
entries.options_raw: ক) was খ) is গ) were ঘ) are
entries.explanation: 'One of the + plural noun' গঠনে subject-এর সংখ্যা 'one' — singular; সাথে 'yesterday' থাকায় past tense 'was' বসবে।

entries.question_text: She talked as though she ___ the CEO of the company.
entries.options_raw: ক) was খ) were গ) had ঘ) had been

entries.question_text: 'Bolt from the blue' means —
entries.options_raw: ক) a danger with warning খ) a danger without warning গ) hard danger ঘ) powerful danger
entries.explanation: 'A bolt from the blue' idiom — সম্পূর্ণ অপ্রত্যাশিত ও আকস্মিক ঘটনা/দুঃসংবাদ (বাংলা 'বিনা মেঘে বজ্রপাত')।

entries.question_text: Adjective form of 'ambition' is —

entries.explanation: Ambition (noun) → Ambitious (adj.) — উচ্চাকাঙ্ক্ষী।

entries.correct_answer: ঘ) Nowadays women are playing important role in all spheres of life.

entries.question_text: I fancy I ___ (turn) a trifle pale.

entries.question_text: He fell ___ a trap.
entries.options_raw: ক) of খ) off গ) into ঘ) out
entries.explanation: 'Fall into a trap' একটি নির্দিষ্ট collocation — ফাঁদে পড়া। যেমন: Don't fall into their trap.

entries.question_text: I would rather die —

entries.explanation: 'Would rather + base verb + than + base verb' গঠন। "I would rather die than beg" — ভিক্ষা করার চেয়ে আমি বরং মরব।

entries.question_text: The prince has no ambition ___ the throne.
entries.options_raw: ক) to খ) with গ) of ঘ) for
entries.explanation: 'Ambition for something' — কোনো কিছুর জন্য উচ্চাকাঙ্ক্ষা। যেমন: He has no ambition for wealth.

entries.question_text: Which is the noun of the word 'wise'?
entries.options_raw: ক) Wise খ) Wisdom গ) Wisely ঘ) Wish
entries.explanation: Wise (adj.) — জ্ঞানী; Wisdom (noun) — জ্ঞান, প্রজ্ঞা। Wisely (adv.)।

entries.question_text: 'Ups and downs' means —
entries.options_raw: ক) thoroughly খ) move upward and downward গ) here and there ঘ) rise and fall
entries.explanation: 'Ups and downs' idiom — জীবনের সুখ-দুঃখ, উত্থান-পতন (rise and fall)। যেমন: Life has its ups and downs.

entries.question_text: The verb form of 'strong' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) strength খ) strong গ) strengthen ঘ) stronger
entries.explanation: Strong (adj.) → Strengthen (verb) — শক্তিশালী করা। Strength (noun); Stronger (comparative)।

entries.question_text: The antonym of 'Honorary' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) official খ) honorable গ) salaried ঘ) literary
entries.explanation: 'Honorary' মানে সম্মানসূচক, বেতন ছাড়া। এর বিপরীত 'salaried' — বেতনভুক্ত।

entries.question_text: 'To end in smoke' means —
entries.options_raw: ক) to create fire খ) to go through suffering গ) to come to nothing ঘ) to see fire
entries.explanation: 'End in smoke' idiom — ব্যর্থ হওয়া, কোনো ফল না হওয়া, শূন্যে মিলিয়ে যাওয়া (come to nothing)।

entries.question_text: The synonym of 'Prudent' is —
entries.options_raw: ক) unwise খ) insightful গ) injudicious ঘ) impolite

entries.explanation: NTRCA কর্তৃপক্ষ এই প্রশ্নটি বাতিল ঘোষণা করেছে। (তাত্ত্বিকভাবে 'Let us + verb' রূপান্তরে নিকটতম simple হবে 'We should love our country'।)

entries.question_text: Noun form of the word 'comfortable' is —

entries.explanation: 'Look forward to'-এর 'to' preposition; এর পরে verb-এর ing-form (gerund) 'receiving' বসে।

entries.question_text: I have left the room but he ___ (enter) the room.

entries.explanation: প্রথম clause-এ present perfect ('have left') থাকায় দ্বিতীয় clause-এও present perfect 'has entered' বসবে (সমকালিক ঘটনা)।

entries.explanation: 'Blind to' একটি নির্দিষ্ট collocation — কোনো ত্রুটি/দুর্বলতা দেখেও না দেখা। যেমন: He is blind to his son's mistakes.

entries.explanation: 'Read between the lines' একটি idiom — অর্থ পঙ্‌ক্তির অন্তর্নিহিত বা অপ্রকাশিত অর্থ বুঝে নেওয়া (to grasp the hidden meaning)।

entries.question_text: ___ mother rose in her.

entries.question_text: 'Do you enjoy teaching?' The underlined word is —
entries.options_raw: ক) noun খ) participle গ) gerund ঘ) pronoun
entries.explanation: Verb + ing যখন noun হিসেবে কাজ করে, তখন তাকে gerund বলে। এখানে 'teaching' verb 'enjoy' এর object হিসেবে কাজ করছে — তাই এটি gerund।

entries.question_text: English ___ across the world.

entries.question_text: Who will help you? The passive form is —

entries.question_text: A speech full of many words is —
entries.options_raw: ক) a large speech খ) an ornamental speech গ) maiden speech ঘ) a verbose speech
entries.explanation: 'Verbose' (adj.) — using more words than necessary; বাক্যবহুল, বাচাল। Maiden speech = প্রথম বক্তৃতা; Ornamental speech = অলঙ্কৃত বক্তৃতা।

entries.question_text: The enemy gave in at last. Here 'gave in' means —
entries.options_raw: ক) fled away খ) fainted গ) yielded ঘ) moved back
entries.explanation: 'Give in' (phrasal verb) — to yield / surrender; পরাজিত হয়ে হার মানা, আত্মসমর্পণ করা।

entries.question_text: The phrase 'Get the axe' means —
entries.options_raw: ক) get a new job খ) lose the job গ) cut off relationship ঘ) get an opportunity
entries.explanation: 'Get the axe' একটি idiom — অর্থ চাকরি হারানো, বরখাস্ত হওয়া (to be dismissed from a job)।
